items.title: Untold (Season 7)
items.synopsis: Untold is a sports docuseries that brings fresh eyes to some of the greatest stories in sports. From tennis to boxing to basketball, these stories aren't the ones you've heard before, even if you think you have.
items.brief: A sports docuseries exploring overlooked stories from tennis, boxing, basketball and beyond.

items.title: Rhythm + Flow France (Season 5)
items.synopsis: French rappers freestyle, battle and write their way to a game-changing 100,000 euro prize in a music competition series judged by Niska, Shay and SCH.
items.brief: French rappers compete for 100,000 euros in a music competition judged by Niska, Shay and SCH.

items.title: Stamptown
items.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.
items.brief: A variety show blending circus and comedy acts.

items.title: Facing El Chapo
items.synopsis: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
items.brief: Two Mexican officers must survive their final shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

items.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
items.synopsis: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.
items.brief: A bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, challenging her husband's expectations.

items.title: Outer Banks (Season 5)
items.synopsis: On an island of haves and have-nots, teen John B enlists his three best friends to hunt for a legendary treasure linked to his father's disappearance.
items.brief: Teen John B and his friends hunt for treasure linked to his father's disappearance.

items.title: Blodsoffer
items.synopsis: Detective Berg has given up on his absent ex-cop father - until a double police murder forces them back together.
items.brief: Detective Berg reunites with his estranged ex-cop father after a double police murder.

items.title: S&X
items.synopsis: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.
items.brief: A sex therapist treats patients' intimate issues while concealing his own struggle.

items.title: Chompoo: Lost & Forgotten
items.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?
items.brief: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the police hunt becomes a media sensation.

items.title: Love Is Blind: UK (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Emma and Matt Willis host a social experiment where British singles look for love and get engaged before meeting in person. But who will say "I do"?
items.brief: British singles get engaged before meeting in person in this social experiment.

items.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
items.synopsis: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..
items.brief: An investigation into Boeing's corporate crisis follows whistleblower John Barnett's death.

items.title: Here the Whole Time
items.synopsis: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.
items.brief: An insecure teenager's vacation is disrupted when his neighbor and school crush stays with him.

items.title: Take a Hike!
items.synopsis: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?
items.brief: Four celebrity novices form a hiking club to tackle Korea's snow-capped peaks.

items.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
items.synopsis: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.
items.brief: Kelsey Cook explores hangovers, plane mishaps and dating in this stand-up special.

items.title: Umthetho
items.synopsis: A skilled young public prosecutor is pulled into a brutal prison syndicate led by the brother she thought she lost. Forcing her to choose between justice and family, law and survival, truth and betrayal.
items.brief: A young prosecutor confronts a prison syndicate run by her thought-lost brother.

items.title: Moria
items.synopsis: In this highly stylized fictionalization, Moria Casán transforms her life story into a symbolic spectacle of fame, controversy and ceaseless reinvention.
items.brief: Moria Casán dramatizes her life through fame, controversy and constant reinvention.

items.title: Don’t Say Good Luck
items.synopsis: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.
items.brief: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical.

items.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
items.synopsis: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.
items.brief: Best friends' travel plans are upended when one falls in love with Rebecca.

items.title: To the Max
items.synopsis: Three skydivers died in similar accidents within five years. Salvador Calvo wanted to tell their stories with the sole survivor, Carlos Suárez.
items.brief: Three skydivers died in similar accidents; filmmaker tells their stories with sole survivor Carlos Suárez.

items.title: Tires (Season 3)
items.synopsis: At his father's auto shop, a hapless manager strives to improve customer service and drive profits while keeping his troublemaking cousin in line.
items.brief: A manager at his father's auto shop improves business while keeping his troublemaking cousin in line.

items.title: My Brilliant Career
items.synopsis: Sybylla is a shockingly modern young woman with one searing ambition - to be a writer, while her family is determined to marry her off. With an irrepressible taste for fun, Sybylla breaks every convention of 1900 Australia as she searches for a story that will allow her to write her way to independence. For her, the choice between adventure or marriage seems easy, until she falls in love. Will Sybylla marry, or will she risk it all for a creative life?
items.brief: In 1900 Australia, a woman determined to become a writer navigates family pressure to marry.

items.title: A Child of My Own
items.synopsis: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
items.brief: A woman fakes pregnancy out of desperation and family pressure, becoming entangled in crime.

items.title: MLB Field of Dreams: Phillies vs. Twins (LIVE)
items.synopsis: The Philadelphia Phillies face the Minnesota Twins in a regular-season game at the Field of Dreams ballpark in Dyersville, Iowa — baseball’s return to the cornfields, streamed live on Netflix.
items.brief: The Philadelphia Phillies face the Minnesota Twins at the Field of Dreams ballpark in Iowa.

items.title: This, That and Everything in Between
items.synopsis: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the complexities of their dysfunctional family.
items.brief: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, uncovering painful family secrets.

items.title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
items.synopsis: In never-before-heard prison calls recorded before his death, convicted killer Charles Manson reveals the twisted motivations for his gruesome crimes.
items.brief: In prison recordings, convicted killer Charles Manson reveals his twisted criminal motivations.

items.title: Nando Between Two Worlds
items.synopsis: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.
items.brief: Caught between family and criminal obligations, Nando faces impossible loyalty choices.

items.title: Mourinho
items.synopsis: Iconic game footage, sideline antics, interviews with top footballers and tales from the man himself tell the story of José Mourinho's firecracker career.
items.brief: José Mourinho's fiery football career unfolds through game footage and interviews.

items.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
items.synopsis: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.
items.brief: Rory Scovel performs stand-up exploring home invasions, biblical reenactments and family.

items.title: Dr. Seuss's Red Fish, Blue Fish (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Building a snowman under the sea? Meeting a shark and serving him tea? Red and Blue's days are full of surprises, with ocean pals of all shapes and sizes!
items.brief: Red and Blue experience daily adventures with ocean creatures of all shapes and sizes.

items.title: The Ribbon Hero
items.synopsis: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.
items.brief: When her kingdom is devastated, Princess Sapphire becomes the Ribbon Hero to save her new home.

items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.synopsis: Amnesia, small-town hijinks and a shadowy past — classic tropes collide in this rom-com about a star prosecutor and the boxing coach who upends her life.
items.brief: A star prosecutor and boxing coach navigate romance amid amnesia, small-town drama and secrets.

items.title: Ricky Gervais Alley Cats
items.synopsis: Curl up with a clutter of useless cats as they swear at the telly, debate life's most outrageous questions and cause chaos in the local community.
items.brief: A clutter of cats swear at the television, debate outrageous questions and cause community chaos.

items.title: Operation Safed Sagar: The Untold Story of the Kargil War
items.synopsis: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.
items.brief: The Golden Arrows Air Force squadron undertakes a dangerous mission during the Kargil War.

items.title: Death Inc. (Season 4)
items.synopsis: Staff at a Spanish funeral home wage a black-comedy fight for the director’s chair. In the final season, Chemi takes the job “just for a little while” — and Dámaso cannot decide whether to undermine him or curry favor.
items.brief: Spanish funeral home staff wage a black-comedy battle for the director position in the final season.

items.title: The Last House
items.synopsis: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.
items.brief: A family sealed in their home must survive with dwindling resources and an ominous external threat.

items.title: My Life With the Walter Boys (Season 3)
items.synopsis: In the coming of age show, following the loss of her family in a tragic accident, 16-year old Manhattanite Jackie Howard has to learn to adapt to a new life in rural Colorado with her guardian – and 12 very rowdy kids.
items.brief: A 16-year-old New York girl adapts to life in rural Colorado with her guardian and twelve boys.

items.title: Cien años de soledad (Season 2)
items.synopsis: The story of the Buendia family, who lived for a century in the town of Macondo. It will be the first time that Gabriel García Márquez's seminal novel One Hundred Years of Solitude is adapted for the screen, more than 50 years after it was originally published, in 1967.
items.brief: The Buendia family lives for a century in Macondo in an adaptation of García Márquez's novel.

items.title: 1670 (Season 3)
items.synopsis: In this satirical comedy, a zany nobleman navigates through family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become Poland's most famous figure.
items.brief: A nobleman navigates family feuds and peasant clashes in his quest for Polish fame.

items.title: Let's Marry Harry
items.synopsis: Harry Jowsey is done playing the field. Now, his inner circle is stepping in to help steer his love life, weighing in on every date, every match, and every tough call as he navigates a handpicked pool of potential partners. Is Harry finally ready to find a wife and settle down for good?
items.brief: Harry Jowsey's inner circle guides him through dates with potential partners to find a wife.

items.title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
items.synopsis: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.
items.brief: Comedian Mo Gilligan explores the fried chicken industry through a 28-day diet experiment.

items.title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
items.synopsis: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him…
items.brief: After 27 years, Joachim Posener emerges to discuss the 1997 Trustor affair and his life in hiding.

items.title: Ravu Jôtô (Season 2)
items.synopsis: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.
items.brief: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles live together seeking connection.

items.title: WWE Monday Night RAW (Season 33)
items.synopsis: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.
items.brief: WWE's flagship wrestling program features live matches, celebrity guests and major events.

items.title: Sesame Street: Storm on the Street
items.synopsis: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends learn how to prepare, stay calm, and help neighbors rebuild afterward — with guest stars Post Malone and Michelle Buteau.
items.brief: Elmo and friends learn to prepare for storms, stay calm and help neighbors rebuild.

items.title: The Adam Ray Show
items.synopsis: Same host. Different characters. All chaos. Each week, Adam Ray taps into his roster of alter egos to interview famous guests — and no one is safe.
items.brief: Adam Ray's roster of alter egos interview celebrity guests in this weekly chaotic series.

items.title: K-foodie meets J-foodie (Season 6)
items.synopsis: Korea's top foodie Sung Si-kyung joins Japan's beloved Yutaka Matsushige on a tasty adventure as they explore culinary gems across Korea and Japan.
items.brief: Korean foodie Sung Si-kyung and Japanese actor Yutaka Matsushige explore culinary gems.

items.title: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
items.synopsis: After Pan Am Flight 103 explodes over Lockerbie in 1988, killing 270 people, Scottish police and the FBI join forces in the hunt for those responsible. Based on a true story.
items.brief: Scottish police and the FBI hunt those responsible for Pan Am Flight 103's 1988 explosion.

items.title: Fúria
items.synopsis: Fúria tells the story of a young man rescued from the brink of death by an MMA coach. With no memory of his own identity, he is given the name Marcelo and finds a new purpose in the world of MMA. But as he is drawn deeper into this universe, he begins to uncover clues to his past and becomes entangled in a web of crime, secrets and rivalries that reaches far beyond the cage.
items.brief: A young amnesiac is rescued by an MMA coach and discovers his purpose fighting while uncovering his past.

items.title: The Love Lab
items.synopsis: An innovative dating experiment reality show that breaks away from the conventions of traditional dating programs. Unfamiliar men and women are placed in extreme and controlled environments, facing unexpected experiments such as blind dates in bed and romances in isolation. Through unpredictable situations, the show dynamically captures the participants' raw, instinctive emotions and the realistic changes in their relationships.
items.brief: An innovative dating experiment places participants in extreme scenarios to observe raw emotions.

items.title: Lock Upp (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Fifteen newsworthy celebrities must own their truth in the court of public opinion. Can they control the narrative, or will they be locked out?
items.brief: Fifteen newsworthy celebrities must control their narratives or be locked out by public opinion.

items.title: Proyecto Final
items.synopsis: New school, new start — until vicious online attacks and a classmate's twisted challenge spark a dangerous bond that pushes Tamara toward transformation.
items.brief: A new student faces vicious online attacks and a dangerous challenge that transforms her life.

items.title: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
items.synopsis: From the crime scene to the courtroom, this true-crime series unpacks the University of Idaho murders and the hunt for Bryan Kohberger in forensic detail.
items.brief: This true-crime series unpacks the University of Idaho murders and the hunt for Bryan Kohberger.

items.title: La mujer prohibida
items.synopsis: When Victor Rodríguez saves Karen Arbeláez from being shot during an assassination attempt, their lives become inexplicably intertwined. But reality has a habit of getting in the way of fate: Victor is a famous musician searching for a meaningful connection, and Karen is married to an up-and-coming politician. That doesn't stop their love from growing — even as their obligations, fears, and loved ones' ambitions get in the way.
items.brief: A musician and married woman fall in love despite their complicated circumstances and obligations.

items.title: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
items.synopsis: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.
items.brief: Mary Beth Barone explores relationships, dating apps and absurdities in this stand-up special.

items.title: Better Late Than Single (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?
items.brief: Lifelong singles receive expert guidance on style and confidence as they enter the dating world.

items.title: Bloody Smart
items.synopsis: In a town where strict rules shape students into their "best selves," a hidden Bloodfruit Tree bears crimson fruit. A mysterious boy in black delivers these fruits only to those who truly "need" them. Once received, they awaken long-suppressed desires—gently unravelling the heart, and quietly leading the town toward irreversible collapse.
items.brief: In a strict town, a mysterious boy distributes crimson fruit that awakens suppressed desires.
